services.name: Van Dusen Botanical Garden
services.desc: Among the many interesting sights of the Canadian city of Montreal, the Botanical Gardens, one of the best botanical gardens in the world, undoubtedly deserves special attention. It is located near the Olympic Stadium in the Maisonneuve Park. The initiator of the creation of the botanical garden in Montreal was a talented Canadian botanist Joseph Louis Conrad Marie-Victoren, who took several years to persuade the city authorities to this project. The garden was founded in 1931 at the height of the Great Depression by Montreal Mayor Oud Camillen.
